blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Legacy videos continue to return to contemporary screens through restoration, redistribution, and archival release. Yet their return alone does not ensure that they meet the visual expectations of today’s viewers. The issue is often not what they depict, but the color appearance inherited from earlier imaging pipelines. Limited capture devices, analog or early digital processing, and broadcast transfer can leave persistent color casts, desaturation, reduced contrast, and tonal imbalance. These color and tonal degradations make otherwise valuable footage feel visually dated, motivating color modernization methods that preserve scene content and structure.
blocks.zh: 遗产视频继续通过恢复,再分配,以及档案发行等手段回归当代屏幕. 然而,光靠他们的返回并不能保证他们能满足今天观众的视觉期望。 问题往往不是他们所描绘的,而是早期成像管所继承的颜色外观. 有限的捕捉设备,模拟或早期的数字处理,以及广播传输,都可能留下持久的彩色铸造,去饱和,缩小对比,以及通体失衡. 这些颜色和躯干退化使得其他有价值的镜头感到目视过时,激发出保持场景内容和结构的色彩现代化方法.

blocks.en: Growing interest in AI-assisted remastering, automatic color correction, and reference-based look matching reflects the practical demand for such modernization. However, high-quality results still typically rely on expert colorists to adjust exposure, contrast, and chroma while maintaining consistency across frames and shots. Since this process depends on aesthetic judgment and technical expertise, it scales poorly to long videos with diverse scenes and lighting. These limitations call for automated color modernization that can scale without compromising video coherence.
blocks.zh: 对AI辅助重装,自动色彩校正,以及基于参考的外观相配的兴趣越来越大,反映了这种现代化的实际需要. 然而,高质量的结果仍然通常依赖于专家的色彩学家来调整曝光,对比和染色体,同时保持相框和相片的一致性. 由于这一过程依赖于审美判断和技术专长,因此其规模差到长视频,画面和照明各异. 这些限制需要自动化的色彩现代化,在不损害视频一致性的情况下可以进行规模化.

blocks.en: We formalize this problem as long video color modernization : adjusting the color and tone of legacy footage toward a broadly contemporary appearance while preserving scene content and structure. Unlike restoration ( Chan et al. 2022 ; Lin and Simo-Serra 2024 ; Mao et al. 2025 ; Wan et al. 2022 ) , which aims to recover degraded visual signals, and colorization ( Lei and Chen 2019 ; Zhang et al. 2019 ; Yang et al. 2024 ; Chen et al. 2024 ) , which infers missing chroma for grayscale footage, our goal is to modernize footage that already contains color yet appears visually dated.
blocks.zh: 将传统镜头的颜色和音调调整为广泛的当代外观, 与修复不同(Chan等2022;Lin和Simo-Serra 2024;Mao等. 2025; Wan等 2022),旨在恢复已退化的视觉信号并进行色化(Lei和Chen 2019;Zhang等. 2019; 杨等. 2024; Chen等 2024),由此推断出灰度镜头缺失的染色体,我们的目标是使已经包含颜色但出现视觉日期的镜头现代化.

blocks.en: This formulation raises two technical challenges and one evaluation challenge. First, image-level modernization is underdetermined. Modern color is not a unique target: multiple color grades may be perceived as contemporary, and paired old-to-modern supervision is generally unavailable. Second, long videos require color transformations that are both shot-adaptive and video-coherent. Frame-dependent transformations can fluctuate with content and introduce flicker, whereas a single global transformation can fail to account for shot-specific lighting and color statistics. Effective modernization must therefore remain stable within each shot while avoiding arbitrary grade drift across visually related shots. Third, to our knowledge, evaluating long video color modernization remains underexplored. Existing assessments largely focus on individual images ( Gunawan et al. 2023 ) or short clips ( Chen et al. 2017 ; Deng et al. 2021 ; Wen et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2023 ; Kar and Su 2025 ) , leaving the broader requirements of long multi-shot videos less systematically examined. A meaningful evaluation therefore requires a multidimensional assessment encompassing perceived modernness, content preservation, temporal stability, cross-shot grade coherence, perceptual quality, and efficiency.
blocks.zh: 这一提法提出了两个技术挑战和一个评价挑战。 首先,图像层面的现代化不够确定。 现代取色并不是一个独特的目标:多色分级可能被视为当代取色,而成对的旧到现代的监制一般都不可用. 第二,长相视频需要色调转换,既能使相片适应又能使相片一致. 依赖框架的转换可以随内容而起起起伏并引入闪烁器,而单一的全球转换则不能说明特定照明和颜色统计。 因此,有效的现代化必须在每一镜头中保持稳定,同时避免在视觉相关镜头之间任意分级漂移。 第三,据我们所知,对长视频颜色现代化的评估仍然没有得到充分利用。 现有评估主要侧重于个人图像(Gunawan等2023年)或短片(Chen等. 2017; 邓等. 2021; 温等. 2023; 陈等. 2023; Kar and Su 2025)),使得对长相多镜头视频的更广泛要求没有那么系统地审查. 因此,要进行有意义的评价,就必须进行多层面的评估,包括感知的现代化、内容保存、时间稳定性、跨镜头级别的一致性、观念质量和效率。

blocks.en: To address these technical challenges, we propose a scalable framework that combines keyframe modernization with shot-level propagation. We first divide the input video into shots and select one representative keyframe per shot. Temporally adjacent keyframes are then packed into a grid and jointly modernized using a pretrained text-guided image editing model ( Black Forest Labs et al. 2025 ) . The model’s learned generative prior provides plausible contemporary references without paired supervision, while joint processing promotes coherent grading across neighboring shots. Finally, we fit a compact, shot-specific transform to each source–modernized keyframe pair and propagate its chromatic and tonal adjustments throughout the corresponding shot. Per-shot estimation accommodates variations in lighting and color statistics, while applying the same pixelwise transform throughout each shot maintains stable grading without altering spatial structure. By applying generative editing only to representative keyframes, the framework scales efficiently to long multi-shot videos.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些技术挑战,我们建议建立一个可扩展的框架,将关键框架的现代化同射程传播结合起来。 我们首先将输入视频分为镜头,每镜头选择一个有代表性的键框. 然后,将相邻的临时键框装入网格,并使用经过事先训练的文字制导图像编辑模型联合现代化(黑森林实验室等,2025年)。 该模型的先入为主的学问提供了可信的当代参考,而不提供对等监督,而联合处理则有助于在相邻的镜头中进行连贯的分级。 最后,我们配上一个紧凑的、针对镜头的变换到每个源 — — 现代化的键框配对,并在整个相应镜头中宣传其色调和通体调整。 每发估计能容纳照明和色彩统计的变化,同时在整个镜头中采用相同的像素变换,保持平分稳定而不会改变空间结构. 通过将基因编辑只应用到具有代表性的键框上,框架高效地缩放到多镜头长视频上.

blocks.en: To systematically assess long video color modernization, we curate a diverse evaluation set of multi-shot legacy videos from the Condensed Movies Dataset ( Bain et al. 2020 ) , spanning five decades of footage. We evaluate perceived modernness through a user study and complement it with quantitative measures of content preservation, temporal stability, perceptual quality, and efficiency. We further introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC), which evaluates inter-shot grade coherence by weighting shot-pair comparisons according to source color similarity. Among the eight evaluated versions, our framework achieves the best mean rank for perceived modernness, whereas several baselines do not surpass the unedited original. It also remains competitive across the complementary quantitative criteria.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评估长视频色彩现代化,我们整理了一套来自"凝聚电影数据集"(Bain等人,2020年)的多镜头后遗录的多镜头评价片段,拍摄时间长达50年. 我们通过用户研究来评价所认识到的现代性,并以内容保存、时间稳定性、感知质量和效率等量化措施来补充。 我们还引入了"SW-IGC"(SW-IGC)的Source-Wighted Inter-shot Classionity(英语:SW-IGC),通过根据源色相相相近性来进行相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相. 在8个评价的版本中,我们的框架对所感知的现代性达到了最优的平分,而若干基线并没有超过未经编辑的原文。 它还在补充性数量标准方面保持竞争力。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: (i) we formulate long video color modernization as a distinct task for updating the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage; (ii) we propose a scalable framework that jointly modernizes temporally adjacent keyframes and propagates their adjustments through compact, shot-specific color transforms; and (iii) we provide a multidimensional evaluation of this task, combining human judgments of perceived modernness with complementary quantitative measures and introducing SW-IGC for inter-shot grade coherence.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面:(一) 我们制定长相视频色彩现代化方案,作为更新传统色彩镜头的色相和外观的独特任务;(二) 我们提出一个可扩展的框架,通过紧凑的、有镜头特有色彩的色彩转换,共同实现相接键框的现代化并宣传其调整;(三) 我们对这项任务进行多层面评价,将人对所感知的现代性的判断与补充性量化措施结合起来,并采用SW-IGC进行相接分级一致性。

We then jointly modernize temporally adjacent keyframes. Finally, we estimate a shot-specific color mapping from each original–modernized keyframe pair and apply it to all frames in the corresponding shot.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Reference-based Image Color Style Transfer
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于参考的图像颜色样式传输

blocks.en: Modernizing the color appearance of legacy footage is closely related to color grading, in which colorists adjust color and tone to achieve a desired visual look rather than recover a single objectively correct appearance. Because such an appearance is subjective and lacks a unique ground truth, it can be specified through a reference image and approached through color style transfer.
blocks.zh: 将遗留镜头的色彩外观现代化与色彩分级密切相关,其中色彩学家会调整色彩和语气,以达到所期望的视觉外观,而不是恢复单一客观正确的外观. 由于这样的外观是主观的,缺乏独特的地底真理,因此可以通过参考图像来指定,并通过颜色风格转移来接近.

blocks.en: Previous methods transfer color from source–reference image pairs either by aligning feature statistics or by predicting color operators. Feature-statistics-based methods, such as WCT variants ( Li et al. 2017 ; Li et al. 2018 ; An et al. 2020 ; Chiu and Gurari 2022 ; Wen et al. 2023 ) , whiten source features and recolor them using the statistics of the reference features. In contrast, color operators are commonly represented as locally affine bilateral grids ( Xia et al. 2020 ) or parametric color mappings ( Ho and Zhou 2021 ; Ke et al. 2023 ; Larchenko et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025 ; Gong et al. 2025 ) . Since these methods alter image appearance without explicitly modifying spatial structure, they generally preserve image layout and can be applied at high resolution.
blocks.zh: 先前的方法通过对齐特征统计或预测颜色操作符来从源 - 参考图像对来传输颜色. 基于地物-统计学的方法,如: WPT变体(Li等2017;Li等. 2018; An等编. 2020; Chiu and Gurari 2022; Wen等 2023.),白取源地特征并使用参考地特征统计重新取色. 相形之下,彩色运营商通常代表为本地同芬双边网格(霞等2020年)或参数色映射(何和周2021;克等. 2023; 拉尔琴科等. 2025; 李等 2025; 龚等 2025.). 由于这些方法在没有明确修改空间结构的情况下会改变图像外观,因此它们一般保留了图像布局并可以在高分辨率下被应用.

blocks.en: Our scalable framework supports various color-propagation methods, but prioritizes deterministic color mapping over inference-time style transfer for efficient long-video processing. Our evaluation shows that this training-free approach provides sufficient visual quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的可缩放框架支持各种色相传播方法,但优先考虑确定色相映射,而不是推论-时间风格的传输,以便高效地进行长视频处理. 我们的评估表明,这种无培训的办法提供了足够的视觉质量。

blocks.en: 2.2 Video Color Grading
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频颜色分级

blocks.en: Extending reference-based color style transfer to video requires keeping the appearance consistent across frames. Existing studies ( Li et al. 2019 ; Deng et al. 2021 ; Wu et al. 2022 ; Wen et al. 2023 ; Kar and Su 2025 ) estimate a transformation operator for each frame or map an operator to the video without any temporal component such as optical flow or a temporal loss. These methods mainly address a single shot or a short clip, and do not explicitly consider coherent grading across the many shots of a long-form video.
blocks.zh: 将基于参考的颜色风格转移到视频中需要保持外观跨帧的一致性. 现有研究(李等. 2019; 邓等. 2021; 吴等. 2022; 温等. 2023; Kar and Su 2025))估计每个帧的变相操作器或将一个操作器映射到视频上,没有光学流等任何时间成分或时间损失. 这些方法主要针对一镜头或短片,没有明确考虑在长片视频的许多镜头中进行连贯分级.

blocks.en:
Even studies that explicitly target video color grading ( Shin et al. 2025 ; Guo et al. 2026 ) treat a sequence as one continuous clip, and do not address the color inconsistency that arises within a shot or between shots. Shin et al. (2025) generate a LUT learned from a source–reference pair, but apply that single LUT to the entire video, irrespective of shot boundaries. Guo et al. (2026) use LLM-based RAG and a tree-of-thoughts procedure to determine the parameters of a single 3D LUT, which is likewise applied uniformly across the whole log video.
Recent video generation models offer flexible end-to-end manipulation ( Jiang et al. 2025 ; Yang et al. 2025 ) , but are developed primarily for synthesizing or editing short, motion-rich clips rather than preserving the source content exactly. Their generative formulation can introduce unintended content changes and temporal inconsistencies, while the high cost of dense generation limits their applicability to long-form video modernization.
blocks.zh:
甚至明确针对视频颜色分级的研究(Shin等. 2025; 郭等 2026)将一个序列作为连续片段处理,不处理镜头内或镜头间出现的颜色不一致. 申等编. (2025)生成一个从源–参考对中学习到的LUT,但将这个单个LUT应用到整个视频中,不管镜头边界. Guo等人(2026年)使用基于LLM的RAG和思维之树程序来确定单一3D LUT的参数,这同样被统一应用于整个日志视频.
近期的视频生成模型提供了灵活的端到端操纵(Jiang等人,2025;Yang等人,2025),但开发主要是为了合成或编辑短片,运动丰富的片段,而不是精确地保留出源内容. 它们的基因配制可以引入出乎意料的内容变化和时间上的不一致,而密集生成的高昂成本限制了它们适用于长式视频现代化.

blocks.en: 3.2 Keyframe Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.2 关键框架提取

blocks.en: To support efficient shot-level color propagation, we partition each video into shots and select one representative keyframe per shot through boundary detection, segment merging, and keyframe selection.
blocks.zh: 为了支持高效的相片级别颜色传播,我们将每段视频分成相片,并通过边界探测、片段合并和相片框选择,选择每个相片具有代表性的键框。

blocks.en: We detect candidate boundaries using TransNet V2 ( Souček and Lokoč 2024 ) with a recall-oriented low threshold, preventing a single color mapping from spanning distinct shots. To correct false splits caused by flashes or rapid motion, we greedily merge adjacent segments when the DINOv2 ( Oquab et al. 2024 ) cosine similarity between the frames immediately surrounding their boundary exceeds a threshold. This semantic criterion helps distinguish transient within-shot appearance changes from true boundaries between distinct shots.

blocks.en: For each shot, we sample candidate frames and use a vision–language model ( Bai et al. 2025 ) to select the clearest and most representative one, since visual clarity and shot representativeness are difficult to capture with a single heuristic. This keyframe serves both as the modernization input and as the reference for shot-level color propagation.
blocks.zh: 每一镜头,我们都会对候选帧进行抽样,并使用一种视觉语言模型(Bai等人,2025年)来选择最清晰和最具代表性的一镜头,因为视觉清晰度和镜头代表性很难用单一的heuristic来捕捉. 这个关键框架既可作为现代化的投入,也作为射出一级颜色传播的参考。

blocks.en: 3.3 Image-Level Modernization
blocks.zh: 3.3 图像层面的现代化

blocks.en: Image modernization is inherently ill-posed: there is no single ground-truth modernized result, and paired legacy and modern versions of the same visual content are generally unavailable. We therefore do not learn a direct old-to-modern mapping from paired supervision. Instead, we employ a pretrained text-guided image editing model to modernize the selected keyframes. Specifically, we use FLUX.1-Kontext ( Black Forest Labs et al. 2025 ) with a fixed instruction that requests natural, contemporary color and tonal adjustments while preserving the original visual content and composition.
blocks.zh: 图像现代化本身就存在缺陷:没有单一的地面真象现代化结果,同样视觉内容的成对遗产和现代版本一般都不存在。 因此,我们没有从对等监督中学习直接的老到现代绘图。 相反,我们采用了一个经过预先训练的文本制导的图像编辑模型来使选定的键框现代化. 具体来说,我们使用FLUX.1-Kontext(黑森林实验室等2025年)的固定指令,要求自然地,当代地色和通体调整,同时保留了原始的视觉内容和组成.

blocks.en: Processing each keyframe independently may produce inconsistent color rendering across neighboring shots. To improve inter-shot consistency, we adopt a three-step joint modernization procedure. First, during keyframe packing , we pack up to four temporally adjacent keyframes into a 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid. We then perform joint keyframe modernization by editing the packed grid in a single model invocation. By exposing the model to neighboring shots simultaneously, this joint processing encourages consistent chromatic and tonal adjustments across them. Finally, during keyframe unpacking , we split the edited grid into individual modernized keyframes. Each modernized keyframe is subsequently paired with its original counterpart to estimate the color mapping for the corresponding shot.
blocks.zh: 独立处理每个键框可能会产生相邻镜头之间不连贯的色彩渲染. 为了提高相接的一致性,我们采取了三步走的联合现代化程序。 首先,在键框包装过程中,我们将最多四个时间相邻的键框打入一个2×2 2.\times 2格. 然后我们进行联合键盘现代化,用单一的模型引用来编辑被包装的网格。 通过同时将模型暴露在相邻的镜头中,这种联合处理鼓励它们之间一致的色调和通体调整. 最后,在按键框架解开时,我们把经过编辑的网格分成单个现代化的按键框架。 每个已更新的键框随后被与原来的对等相配来估计相应镜头的颜色映射.

blocks.en: 3.4 Color Propagation
blocks.zh: 3.4 彩色宣传

blocks.en: This stage consists of two components. We first estimate a shot-specific color transform from each legacy–modernized keyframe pair, and then apply it consistently to all frames in the corresponding shot with highlight roll-off.
blocks.zh: 这个阶段由两个部分组成. 我们首先从每一个遗留的-现代的键框对中估算出一个相片特定颜色的变换,然后用亮点滚出的方式一致地应用到相应的相片中的所有相片上.

blocks.en: For each shot s s , we compute a global affine mapping that transports the RGB color distribution of its selected legacy keyframe to that of its modernized counterpart. Since the modernization stage targets primarily chromatic and tonal adjustments while preserving scene content, a single global mapping provides a compact approximation that can be applied pixelwise without altering spatial structure.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether our framework produces perceptually convincing modern color appearances while preserving source fidelity and temporal consistency. We assess modern color preference through a user study, complement it with quantitative and qualitative analyses, and examine key design choices across the framework through ablation studies.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们的框架是否在保持源的忠诚性和时间一致性的同时,产生了能令人信服的现代颜色外观。 我们通过用户研究评估现代色彩偏好,辅之以定量和定性分析,并通过消化研究审查整个框架的关键设计选择。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate on a curated subset of the Condensed Movies Dataset ( Bain et al. 2020 ) , a large-scale collection of key scenes from thousands of films. To capture diverse color characteristics across eras, we sample 20 videos per decade from the 1960s through the 2000s, yielding 100 videos, 3.9 hours of footage, and 3,390 shots. Each video is 2–4 minutes long; these short excerpts increase content diversity, while our framework is not limited to such durations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了"凝聚的电影数据集"(Bain等人,2020年)的一个被整理的子集,这是从上千部电影中大规模收集的关键场景. 为了捕捉跨时代的不同颜色特征,我们从1960年代到2000年代每十年抽取20个视频,产生100个视频,3.9小时的镜头,以及3,390个镜头. 每段视频长2至4分钟;这些简短的节选增加了内容多样性,而我们的框架并不局限于这种持续时间。

blocks.en: We consider two families of baselines, categorized by which stages of our framework they replace.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,基线分为两组,按我们框架的哪个阶段来取而代之。

blocks.en: End-to-end video editing. We compare against two end-to-end video editors, CogVideoX-5B ( Yang et al. 2025 ) and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B ( Jiang et al. 2025 ) , which directly modernize the input video without explicit keyframe processing or color propagation. This comparison evaluates whether dense video editing can preserve source content and temporal coherence over long videos.
blocks.zh: 端到端视频编辑. 我们比较了两个端到端的视频编辑器CogVideoX-5B(Yang等2025年)和Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B(Jiang等2025年),它们直接将输入视频现代化,而没有明确的键框处理或色彩传播. 这一比较评价了密集的视频编辑能否保持源内容和时间上相对于长视频的一致性.

blocks.en: Modular color propagation. The second family replaces only the propagation stage of our framework. We retain the same shot boundaries and modernized reference keyframes, and use CAP-VSTNet ( Wen et al. 2023 ) , Neural Preset ( Ke et al. 2023 ) , Video Color Grading (VCG) ( Shin et al. 2025 ) , and SA-LUT ( Gong et al. 2025 ) to transfer the reference color grade to all frames within each shot. This controlled comparison isolates the effect of the propagation mechanism.
blocks.zh: 模式色彩传播. 第二个家庭只能取代我们框架的传播阶段。 我们保留相同的镜头边界和现代化的参考键框,并使用CAP-VSTNet(Wen等2023年),Neural Preset(Ke等2023年),VCG(Shin等2025年),SA-LUT(Gong等2025年),将参考取色分级转移到每个镜头的所有帧. 这种有控制的比较隔离了传播机制的效果。

blocks.en: Video modernization is inherently a one-to-many problem, as multiple color grades can provide valid modern renditions of the same source video, precluding evaluation against a single ground-truth grade. We therefore assess perceived modern color appearance through human judgments as the primary evaluation objective, complemented by measures of structural preservation, intra-shot temporal color consistency, perceptual and aesthetic quality, inter-shot grade consistency, and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 视频现代化本质上是一个一对多的问题,因为多色分数可以提供同一源视频的有效现代移取,排除了对单一地面真实分数的评价. 因此,我们通过人类判断评估现代颜色的外观,将其作为首要评价目标,并辅之以结构保存、镜头内时间颜色一致性、视觉和美学质量、镜头间等级一致性和计算效率等措施。

blocks.en: Modern color preference. We conduct a blinded user study with 65 participants recruited via Prolific to evaluate perceived modern color appearance. Each participant evaluates the same 15 video sets in randomized order. For each video, participants simultaneously view eight anonymized versions in a grid—the output of our method, the source video, and six baseline outputs—with their positions randomized. Including the source video allows us to assess whether the edited outputs are perceived as more contemporary than the original, beyond their relative preference among competing methods. Participants rank all eight versions from 1 (best) to 8 (worst) by modern color appearance (judged on color alone) and temporal consistency of colors and content. The 975 rankings are summarized by Mean Rank, Rank-1, Top-3, and the full rank distribution.
blocks.zh: 现代色彩偏好. 我们进行了盲目的用户研究,通过Prolific征聘了65名参与者,以评估所认为的现代颜色外观。 每个参与者按随机排列的顺序评价相同的15个相机. 对于每段视频,参与者同时在网格中查看了8个匿名版本——我们方法的输出,源视频,以及6个基线输出,其位置随机排列. 包括源视频让我们能够评估所编辑的产出是否被认为比原作更现代,超出了它们相互竞争方法的相对偏好. 参与者通过现代色彩外观(仅以色彩判断)以及色彩和内容的时间一致性,将所有8个版本从1个(最佳)到8个(最糟糕)排序. 975名排名按Mean Rank,Rank-1,TOP-3和正军衔分布汇总.

blocks.en: Structural and temporal consistency. We evaluate structural preservation using Edge-SSIM ( Wang et al. 2004 ; Soria et al. 2022 ) and intra-shot temporal color consistency using CDC ( Liu et al. 2024 ) , which measures temporal variation in framewise color distributions.
blocks.zh: 结构和时间一致性。 我们使用Edge-SSIM(Wang等人,2004年;Soria等人,2022年)来评价结构保存,并使用CDC(Liu等人,2024年)来测量镜头内时间颜色一致性,该方法测量帧颜色分布的时间变化。

blocks.en: Perceptual and aesthetic quality. We assess perceptual quality using DeQA-Score ( You et al. 2025 ) and the quality score of Q-Align ( Wu et al. 2024 ) (Q-Align Q ), and aesthetic quality using its aesthetic score (Q-Align A ).
blocks.zh: 认知和审美质量. 我们用"德QA-Score"(您等2025年)和"Q-Align"(吴等2024年)(Q-Align Q)的质量分数来评估知觉质量,"Q-Align Q"则用其美学分数来评估美学质量(Q-Align A.

blocks.en: Efficiency. We measure the propagation throughput in frames per second.
blocks.zh: 效率。 我们测量每秒传播量

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.2 比较

blocks.en: Figure 2: Distribution of contemporary color preference rankings over 975 complete rankings. Each bar shows the proportions of Rank 1, Ranks 2–3, and Ranks 4–8, with the mean rank reported on the right.
blocks.zh: 图 2:当代色彩偏好排名分布超过975个完整排名. 每个栏目显示1等分、2等分、4等分、8等分,其中右栏为平均分。

blocks.en: Fig. 2 shows a clear overall preference for our method. Ours achieves the lowest mean rank of 2.31, which is 0.71 lower than that of CAP-VSTNet, the strongest baseline, and 1.31 lower than that of the source video. It receives the top rank in 37.9% of rankings, more than twice the 17.6% achieved by CAP-VSTNet, and places within the top three in 81.7%, compared with 66.3% for CAP-VSTNet. The two end-to-end editors receive the worst mean ranks, highlighting source preservation as essential to successful modernization. Neural Preset and SA-LUT rank below the source despite using the same modernized keyframes, showing that keyframe quality alone does not ensure effective video-level results.

The end-to-end video editing methods substantially alter the source content, yielding markedly lower Edge-SSIM scores of 0.439–0.535, compared with 0.745–0.886 for the modular methods. As shown in Tab. 2 , independent modernization produces the highest SW-IGC, indicating large variation in inter-shot color mappings. Post-hoc smoothing reduces SW-IGC most effectively, but retains full inference cost and cannot coordinate keyframe appearances during generation. The two packing strategies achieve comparable SW-IGC, indicating little benefit from explicit source color clustering for overall inter-shot consistency. blocks.en: We examine the design of the shot-specific color propagation operator. Diagonal independently matches the mean and standard deviation of each channel, MKL matches the full covariance to model cross-channel correlations, and Histogram performs independent per-channel CDF matching. We further evaluate MKL + roll-off , which augments the MKL mapping with a luma-based highlight roll-off before final clipping to the valid RGB range. For the quantitative evaluation, each mapping is applied to the source keyframe used for fitting. We compare the resulting keyframe with its modernized counterpart using the sliced-Wasserstein distance (SWD) in CIELAB for reference fidelity, and with the original source keyframe using Edge-SSIM for structural preservation.

blocks.en: Tab. 3 shows a trade-off between reference fidelity and structural preservation. Diagonal retains high Edge-SSIM but yields the largest SWD, indicating that independent channel-wise statistics have limited expressiveness for reproducing the target color distribution. In contrast, Histogram achieves the smallest SWD by independently matching the CDF of each source channel to that of the corresponding channel in the modernized keyframe, but yields the lowest Edge-SSIM. Fig. 5 (A) qualitatively illustrates this trade-off. By modeling cross-channel correlations, MKL reduces SWD by 9.6 % 9.6\% relative to Diagonal while maintaining nearly identical Edge-SSIM, providing a more favorable balance between the two criteria. MKL + roll-off performs comparably to MKL in the fitting-keyframe evaluation while reducing clipping-induced highlight saturation on propagated frames, as shown in Fig. 5 (B). We therefore adopt it as our final propagation operator.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a scalable framework for long video color modernization. Our framework jointly modernizes packed keyframes from neighboring shots using the generative prior of a pretrained text-guided image editing model. It then propagates the modernized colors throughout each shot using a deterministic, shot-specific color mapping. Extensive experiments show that our results are perceived as having the most contemporary color appearance. Our framework also achieves the best inter-shot color consistency among the compared methods using lightweight, training-free color propagation, while remaining competitive on the other quantitative metrics. These results demonstrate a practical approach to modernizing long-form video archives without compromising their original content or coherence.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了长相视频色彩现代化的可扩展框架. 我们的框架共同将组合的按键框从相邻的镜头中现代化,在经过事先训练的文字制导图像编辑模型之前使用基因化. 然后,它用一个定型的,特定相片的颜色映射法,在每一镜头中传播现代化的颜色。 广泛的实验表明,我们的结果被认为具有最当代的色彩外观. 我们的框架还实现了使用轻量级、无训练色彩传播的比较方法之间最佳的相接相色一致性,同时在其他量化指标上保持竞争力。 这些结果表明,在不损害长式录像档案原始内容或一致性的情况下,采用切实可行的方法使这些档案现代化。

blocks.en: B.1 Keyframe Extraction

blocks.en: We adopt TransNet V2 ( Souček and Lokoč 2024 ) to detect candidate shot boundaries. TransNet V2 is an efficient shot transition detection network that processes a sequence of neighboring frames and predicts a per-frame boundary probability, enabling fast shot segmentation of long videos. We threshold this probability at 0.1 0.1 , a deliberately recall-oriented choice: a missed boundary would cause a single color mapping to span distinct shots, whereas false positives merely over-segment the video and are corrected in the subsequent merging stage. Consecutive boundary predictions are consolidated into a single cut at the probability peak, yielding a contiguous, non-overlapping partition of the entire video.
blocks.zh: 我们采用TransNet V2(Souček和Lokoč 2024)来检测候选人的射击边界。 转 净额 V2是一个高效的镜头过渡检测网络,它处理相邻帧的序列并预测出每帧的边界概率,使得长相视频能快速地进行镜头分解. 我们把这一概率定在0.1, 一种刻意取回的选择: 缺失的边界会导致单一的颜色映射, 相接的边界预测在概率峰值被整合成一刀一刀,产生整个视频的相接性,非相重叠分出.

blocks.en: The recall-oriented threshold may over-segment a continuous shot in the presence of flashes or rapid motion. To correct these false splits, we compare the frames immediately before and after each candidate boundary using the cosine similarity of their pooled DINOv2-S embeddings ( Oquab et al. 2024 ) , and greedily merge adjacent segments whose similarity exceeds a merge threshold of 0.8 0.8 , so that a shot split into multiple fragments is fully recombined. This semantic criterion helps distinguish transient within-shot appearance changes from true boundaries between distinct shots.

blocks.en: The selected keyframe serves as both the modernization input and the color reference for its shot, so it must satisfy three requirements at once: it should be sharply focused, representative of the shot’s content and color, and an actual film frame rather than a title card, poster, or other graphic that legacy clips frequently contain. These joint requirements are difficult to capture with a single hand-crafted criterion, so we cast selection as a holistic judgment by a vision–language model. From each shot, we uniformly sample 16 candidate frames and query Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al. 2025 ) once using the fixed instruction shown below; the returned index determines the shot’s keyframe. Here, {N} is replaced by the number of candidate frames at query time.

blocks.en: B.2 Image-Level Modernization
blocks.zh: B.2 图像层面的现代化

blocks.en: We pack up to four temporally adjacent keyframes into a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 image grid. When fewer than four keyframes are available, we fill the unused grid cells by repeating the available keyframes rather than using constant-valued padding. This avoids introducing large uniform regions that are atypical of natural images and may interfere with image editing. The packed grid is modernized in a single model invocation and subsequently unpacked into individual modernized keyframes, retaining only the outputs corresponding to the original keyframes.
blocks.zh: 我们把四个时间上相邻的键盘 装入一个2×2 2×2的图像网格 当可用的键框少于4个时,我们通过重复可用的键框来填充未使用的网格单元格,而不是使用常值活化的活化. 这避免了引入大型同质区域,这些区域是自然图像的典型,可能干扰图像编辑. 组合式网格在单一的模型引用中进行了现代化,并随后被拆分成单个的现代化键框,仅保留与原始键框对应的输出.

blocks.en: We use FLUX.1-Kontext ( Black Forest Labs et al. 2025 ) , a 12B-parameter flow-matching model for in-context image generation and editing, as the keyframe editor. Each packed grid is resized to the nearest supported resolution and edited in a single model invocation using the fixed instruction shown below, with a guidance scale of 2.5 2.5 and 30 30 sampling steps. Although the model is not specifically trained for grid-structured inputs, it generally applies coherent color and tonal adjustments across cells while preserving the content of each keyframe. blocks.en: We curate a subset of the Condensed Movies Dataset ( Bain et al. 2020 ) through a two-stage filtering process. First, we retain videos produced between the 1960s and the 2000s to capture diverse color characteristics across eras. Second, since our task focuses on modernizing existing color rather than colorizing black-and-white footage, we exclude videos consisting predominantly of black-and-white content. From the remaining videos, we randomly sample 20 per decade, resulting in an evaluation set of 100 videos.

blocks.en: D.1 VLMs Cannot Reliably Assess Modern Color

blocks.en: Our primary evaluation is a modern color preference study. Determining whether the dated colors of legacy footage have been sufficiently transformed into a contemporary appearance is inherently subjective, suggesting two possible evaluation strategies: VLM-based evaluation and human evaluation. However, we find that VLM-based judgments are inconsistent and therefore unreliable. Based on Fig. 6 and Tab. 7 , we exclude VLM-based evaluation from our evaluation and instead recruit human participants, highlighting that assessing modern color appearance requires direct human judgment rather than relying solely on existing automated evaluators.

blocks.en: We conduct a user study to evaluate whether each method successfully transforms the colors of legacy footage into a modern style. As shown in Fig. 6 and Tab. 7 , we find that VLM-based evaluation does not provide sufficiently consistent judgments. Determining whether a method produces modern colors and improves upon the original footage is inherently subjective.

blocks.en: We collect a total of 975 rankings from 65 participants and evaluate the results using Mean Rank, Rank-1, and Top-3 rates. blocks.en: E.1 Comparison of Keyframe Selection Strategies
blocks.zh: E.1 关键框架甄选战略比较

blocks.en: Selecting an appropriate keyframe is critical, as it serves both as the input to the image editor and as the color reference for the entire shot. We compare our vision–language model-based selector with four alternatives based on heuristic, statistical, and learned criteria. First frame selects the first frame of each shot, while the color medoid selects the frame whose mean color is closest to the shot-level average. MUSIQ ( Ke et al. 2021 ) selects the frame with the highest no-reference image-quality score, and the DINOv2 medoid ( Oquab et al. 2024 ) selects the frame closest to the mean DINOv2 representation of the shot.
blocks.zh: 选择适当的键框至关重要,因为它既可作为图像编辑器的输入,也作为整个镜头的颜色参考. 我们把我们的愿景-基于语言的模型选择器与基于热力学、统计学和所学标准的四个替代方法进行比较。 第一帧选择每个镜头的第一帧,而彩色素则选择其平均颜色最接近镜头水平平均值的帧. MUSIQ (Ke等 2021) 以最高的无参考图像质量分数选择帧,而DINOv2 medoid (Oquab等 2024) 选择最接近镜头中平均值的DINOv2代表的帧.

blocks.zh: 图7:关键框架选择方法比较。 每行显示用不同方法为同一发所选择的键框;失败情况以红色来概述.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 illustrates representative limitations of these selection criteria, with failure cases outlined in red. First frame is sensitive to shot transitions and rapid motion, and may select blurred frames or views captured before the main subject appears. MUSIQ prioritizes perceptual quality but does not assess shot representativeness, occasionally favoring title cards or poster-like graphics over actual scene content. The DINOv2 medoid favors semantically representative frames but does not explicitly account for image quality, while the color medoid similarly captures color centrality without assessing visual quality or whether the frame contains informative scene content. In contrast, our vision–language model jointly considers visual quality, shot representativeness, and whether each candidate is a valid content frame.
blocks.zh: 图7说明了这些选择标准的代表性局限性,失败案例以红色概述。 第一帧对射击过渡和快速运动敏感,可能会在主体出现前选择模糊的帧或捕捉到的视图. MUSIQ将视觉质量列为优先,但不评估镜头代表性,偶尔会偏好标题卡或海报相类似的图形而优于实际场景内容. DINOv2 medoid偏好精致的代表性框架,但没有明确说明图像质量,而彩色的medoid同样在不评估视觉质量的情况下捕获了色彩中心,或者这个框架是否包含内容丰富的场景内容. 反之,我们的视觉-语言模式共同考虑视觉质量、代表性以及每个候选人是否都是有效的内容框架。

blocks.en: Appendix F Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 附录F 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Our framework has three main limitations. First, joint modernization is restricted to groups of up to four temporally adjacent keyframes. It therefore promotes local cross-shot consistency but does not explicitly coordinate the appearance of distant or recurring shots throughout a long video. Second, shot-level propagation relies on a single global affine color mapping. While this design efficiently preserves spatial structure and temporal stability, it cannot reproduce spatially varying edits or nonlinear local adjustments introduced by the image editor. Third, the method cannot reliably distinguish unintended color degradation from deliberate stylistic choices, such as muted palettes or scene-specific color casts, and may therefore alter the intended visual style.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架有三个主要限制。 首先,联合现代化仅限于最多四个时间相邻的关键框架组。 因此,它促进局部交叉射击的一致性,但没有明确协调在一段长视频中出现遥远或反复出现的镜头。 第二,射入层的传播依赖于单一的全球相克色映射。 虽然这种设计高效地维护了空间结构和时间稳定性,但它无法复制图像编辑器引入的空间差异编辑器或非线性局部调整. 第三,该方法无法可靠地区分出意料的颜色退化与刻意的花式选择,如变形调色板或场景特定颜色的铸造,因此可能改变所要的视觉风格.

blocks.en: Future work could explore hierarchical or memory-based coordination across keyframes to improve long-range coherence while preserving shot-specific flexibility. Spatially adaptive propagation may better capture local edits without sacrificing temporal consistency. Incorporating user input or reference images could also help preserve the intended visual style by specifying the desired degree and direction of modernization. Broader evaluation across genres, production formats, and viewer populations would further clarify how perceptions of contemporary color vary across viewing contexts.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以探讨跨关键框架的分级或基于记忆的协调,以提高远程一致性,同时保持特定灵活性。 空间适应传播可以更好地捕捉本地编辑,同时又不牺牲时间一致性。 纳入用户输入或参考图像还可以通过具体说明现代化的预期程度和方向来帮助保留预期的视觉风格。 对不同流派、生产形式和观众群体进行更广泛的评价将进一步澄清对当代颜色的看法如何因取景而异。
